thag6.12:1.1: Akkodhassa kuto kodho dantassa samajīvino sammadaññāvimuttassa upasantassa tādino. || ||
thag6.12:2.1: tass' eva tena pāpiyyo yo kudhaṃ paṭikujjhati; kuddhaṃ appaṭikujjhanto saṃgāmaṃ jeti dujjayaṃ. || ||
thag6.12:3.1: ubhinnam atthaṃ carati attano ca parassa ca, paraṃ saṃkupitaṃ ñatvā yo sato upasammati. || ||
thag6.12:4.1: ubhinnaṃ tikicchantan taṃ attano ca parassa ca janā maññanti bālo 'ti ye dhammassa akovidā. || ||
thag6.12:5.1: uppajjate sace kodhe, āvajja kakacūpamaṃ; uppajje ce rase taṇhā, puttamaṃsūpamaṃ sara. || ||
thag6.12:6.1: sace dhāvati te cittaṃ kāmesu ca bhavesu ca, khippaṃ niggaṇha satiyā kiṭṭhādaṃ viya duppasun ti. || || Brahmadatto thero.
